home.ingredients_body: At {{restaurant.name_short}}, every bowl starts with springy Taiwanese mifen rice noodles, cooked fresh in just 20 seconds. Choose soup or dry, pick your protein — braised beef, sliced beef, shrimp, chicken, fish, or tofu — then load up on pickled veggies, chili oil, and a fried or quail egg for a bowl that's truly yours.
